sentences.en: Oil is a finite supply and supplies will eventually run dry.
sentences.zh: 石油是一种有限的资源，最终会枯竭。

sentences.en: We cannot have infinite growth on a finite planet.
sentences.zh: 在一个有限的星球上我们不能实现无限增长。

sentences.en: Obviously, the theorem is true for finite sets.
sentences.zh: 显然，对于有限集合该定理是正确的。
